svg.title: Kahn's algorithm on a build graph
svg.desc: Six modules: spring-core and jackson point to spring-web, spring-web and kafka-client point to claims-service, and claims-service points to integration-tests. Each node shows its in-degree. spring-core, jackson and kafka-client start with in-degree 0 and are queued. Taking spring-core and jackson brings spring-web to 0; taking kafka-client and spring-web brings claims-service to 0; taking claims-service brings integration-tests to 0. The order is spring-core, jackson, kafka-client, spring-web, claims-service, integration-tests.
svg.text: Kahn's algorithm: repeatedly take a node with in-degree 0
The badge on each module is its in-degree: how many prerequisites are still unbuilt.

g.text: In-degrees counted. Every node with in-degree 0 is ready.
Take jackson: spring-web now has in-degree 0.
Take spring-web: claims-service now has in-degree 0.
Take claims-service: integration-tests now has in-degree 0.
All 6 nodes are in the order, so there is no cycle.
